Q193655.description: occupation of a person; see also "field of work" (Property:P101), "position held" (Property:P39)

Q193655.label: employer
Q193655.description: person or organization for which the subject works or worked

Q193655.label: place of burial
Q193655.description: location of grave, resting place, place of ash-scattering, etc. (e.g., town/city or cemetery) for a person or animal. There may be several places: e.g., re-burials, parts of body buried separately.

Q193655.label: award received
Q193655.description: award or recognition received by a person, organization or creative work

Q193655.label: image
Q193655.description: image of relevant illustration of the subject; if available, also use more specific properties (sample: coat of arms image, locator map, flag image, signature image, logo image, collage image)

Q193655.label: doctoral advisor
Q193655.description: person who supervised the doctorate or PhD thesis of the subject

Q193655.label: doctoral student
Q193655.description: doctoral student(s) of a professor

Q193655.label: place of birth
Q193655.description: most specific known (e.g. city instead of country, or hospital instead of city) birth location of a person, animal or fictional character

Q193655.label: place of death
Q193655.description: most specific known (e.g. city instead of country, or hospital instead of city) death location of a person, animal or fictional character

Q193655.label: sex or gender
Q193655.description: sex or gender identity of human or animal. For human: male, female, non-binary, intersex, transgender female, transgender male, agender, etc. For animal: male organism, female organism. Groups of same gender use subclass of (P279)

Q193655.label: father
Q193655.description: male parent of the subject. For stepfather, use "stepparent" (P3448)

Q193655.label: country of citizenship
Q193655.description: the object is a country that recognizes the subject as its citizen

Q193655.label: instance of
Q193655.description: that class of which this subject is a particular example and member; different from P279 (subclass of); for example: K2 is an instance of mountain; volcano is a subclass of mountain (and an instance of volcanic landform)

Q193655.label: educated at
Q193655.description: educational institution attended by subject

Q193655.label: described by source
Q193655.description: work where this item is described

Q193655.label: participant in
Q193655.description: event in which a person or organization was/is a participant; inverse of P710 or P1923

Q193655.label: nominated for
Q193655.description: award nomination received by a person, organisation or creative work (inspired from "award received" (Property:P166))

Q193655.label: languages spoken, written or signed
Q193655.description: language(s) that a person or a people speaks, writes or signs, including the native language(s)

Q193655.label: name in native language
Q193655.description: name of a person in their native language

Q193655.label: Erdős number
Q193655.description: the "collaborative distance" between mathematician Paul Erdős and another person. Use point in time (P585) as qualifier and should be used with a source.

Q193655.label: Commons category
Q193655.description: name of the Wikimedia Commons category containing files related to this item (without the prefix "Category:")

Q193655.label: member of
Q193655.description: organization, club or musical group to which the subject belongs. Do not use for membership in ethnic or social groups, nor for holding a political position, such as a member of parliament (use P39 for that)

Q193655.label: archives at
Q193655.description: the institution holding the subject's archives

Q193655.label: on focus list of Wikimedia project
Q193655.description: property to indicate that an item is of particular interest for a Wikimedia project. This property does not add notability. Items should not be created with this property if they are not notable for Wikidata. See also P6104, P972, P2354.

Q193655.label: date of birth
Q193655.description: date on which the subject was born

Q193655.label: date of death
Q193655.description: date on which the subject died

Q193655.label: maintained by WikiProject
Q193655.description: WikiProject that maintains this property, item, or linked pages. If the WikiProject is hosted outside of Wikidata, define the scope using the qualifier "of (P642)"

Q193655.label: family name
Q193655.description: part of full name of person

Q193655.label: given name
Q193655.description: first name or another given name of this person; values used with the property should not link disambiguations nor family names
